stories.title: Berkshire Hathaway Just Bought More of This Brilliant Artificial Intelligence (AI) Stock
stories.simple_summary: Berkshire Hathaway, a famous investment company, bought stock in an AI company. This is a story about what rich investors are doing with their money.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: AI data startup Micro1 reaches $500M gross run rate amid AI training boom
stories.simple_summary: A company called Micro1 is growing fast because many businesses need data to teach AI systems how to work. It's like being a supplier who sells ingredients to many restaurants all at once.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech companies — not something that affects your daily life.

stories.title: Focus: AI reshapes India's IT services sector contracts as clients demand more for less
stories.simple_summary: AI is changing how IT companies in India do business with their clients. Clients want the same work done better but for less money.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to IT workers and investors — not something affecting small business owners outside the tech industry.

stories.title: Micron CEO: AI has 'totally changed' the equation for the boom-and-bust memory industry
stories.simple_summary: AI is changing the memory chip business. The CEO of Micron (a chip company) says AI demand has completely changed how their industry works.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and the tech industry — nothing you need to act on right now.

stories.title: OpenAI is gaining on Anthropic with business users, new data indicates
stories.simple_summary: Different AI companies keep releasing new versions, and businesses keep switching between them to try the latest one. Both companies wonder if customers will stick around long-term.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to worry about.

stories.title: ChatGPT can now send texts for you with new Apple Messages plug-in
stories.simple_summary: ChatGPT (an AI assistant) can now write text messages for you on iPhones through Apple's Messages app. You ask it what to say, and it writes the message for you.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use an iPhone and want help writing texts, this could save you some typing time.

stories.title: Google Discover is getting an AI chatbot-tuned feed
stories.simple_summary: Google's Discover feed (the personalized news section) is getting AI that learns what kinds of stories you want to see. You tell it your preferences, and it remembers them.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Google's news feed, this could make it show you more of what you actually want to read.

stories.title: OK, can we actually cool data centers with our pee?
stories.simple_summary: Someone joked that data centers (huge buildings full of computers) could be cooled using recycled water instead of drinking water. Experts say the idea isn't completely crazy.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly just engineering talk — nothing that affects you directly.

stories.title: Google gives publishers a new way to fight AI-driven traffic losses
stories.simple_summary: Google is giving news publishers a button that lets readers mark them as a favorite source. This could help publishers get more readers since AI search is sending fewer people to websites.
stories.why_it_matters: If you read news online, you might see a button to mark favorite news sources and get their stories more often.

stories.title: Runlayer, Rippling drop lawsuits — but the brouhaha is still a cautionary tale for founders
stories.simple_summary: Two tech companies, Runlayer and Rippling, stopped suing each other. Neither paid money, but one company released a competing product anyway.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to tech business owners and investors — a cautionary tale about how business disputes work in the tech world.

stories.title: OpenAI Halts AI Training on Advanced Model as It Detects Dark Signs Emerging
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI stopped training a new AI model because they noticed something concerning during the process.
stories.why_it_matters: Without more details, it's hard to say how this matters — this is mostly relevant to AI researchers and investors.

stories.title: Linkdaze’s smart calendar is built to run a household, not just track a schedule
stories.simple_summary: A company called Linkdaze made a smart calendar app that also plans meals for you using AI. You don't have to pay extra for the AI features.
stories.why_it_matters: If you struggle with meal planning or calendar management, this free tool might help organize your household.
